title: Barely Modded
description: Made for content creation, this pack contains mods for optimization, aesthetics, and creative building
body:
This pack contains mods for optimization, aesthetics, and creative building.

Meant to be played on a (mostly) vanilla server.

# Optimization
This pack runs with most of the fancy performance mods, like Sodium, FerriteCore and a bunch of culling mods.

# Aesthetics
Distant Horizons to look far. 3D Skin Layers to look fancy. Fresh Animations to look animated. Skin Shuffle to look dapper. MinecraftCapes to look awesome.

The pack also includes a bunch of shaders that play well with Distant Horizons.

# Creative
Features Axiom, Litematica and World Edit to help you in your creative world.

# Customization
Make full use of custom data and resource packs with Entity Sound/Texture/Model Features by Traben. Create armor stands using Armor Poser or the Armor Statues datapack.

# Multiplayer
Use Simple Voice Chat and Status to communicate on servers

# Improvements
- Better Statistics Screen
- AdvancementsFullScreen
- Cubes Without Borders
- Fadeless

# Tools
- AutoRelog
- Xaero's Mini and World map
- Tweakeroo
- Inventory Profiles Next
- Item Scroller
- MiniHUD
- Flashback

## Updates

I'll keep this pack up to date with the latest versions of Minecraft.
